# Technology icon attribution

Icons are stored locally. No CDN or icon font is needed at runtime.

## Devicon

The following original SVG assets come from the official [Devicon repository](https://github.com/devicons/devicon), pinned to commit `7330accdbc47e2dc0c19789a48533c4a3c50fe58`. Devicon is distributed under the MIT license, reproduced in `DEVICON-LICENSE.txt`. Technology names and logos remain trademarks of their respective owners; their inclusion identifies technologies used or studied and does not imply endorsement.

The Spring mark represents the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot. GitHub and Pandas are rendered in a light monochrome treatment for contrast; all project-cover marks are rendered in dark monochrome using CSS. Original files are preserved.

## Testcontainers

[testcontainers.svg](https://github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-java/blob/8e549514e3f01c57d70546fbb8599d138f3903e5/docs/logo.svg) comes from the official Testcontainers Java documentation at commit `8e549514e3f01c57d70546fbb8599d138f3903e5`. The repository MIT license is reproduced in `TESTCONTAINERS-LICENSE.txt`.

## Original concept symbols

`machinelearning.svg`, `microservices.svg`, `restapi.svg`, `sql.svg`, `oop.svg`, `terminal.svg`, and `jpa.svg` were created for this portfolio. They represent concepts and are not vendor logos. The JPA symbol represents object/database mapping rather than a Spring Data trademark.

## Accessibility and motion

The component uses accessible labels and visible hover/focus tooltips. Animations stop under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` or `body.motion-paused`. Image elements specify dimensions in the page markup to avoid layout shifts.
